Order 
By consent of both sides, the writ petition itself is taken up for final disposal at the stage of admission itself.

2. The writ petition has been filed for a mandamus forbearing the respondent No.3 and his subordinates and men from interfering with the petitioner's business by consideration his representation dated 06.06.2024.
3.
The petitioner seeks a direction forbearing the third respondent Food Safety Officer from exercising his statutory duties.

According to the petitioner, at the instruction of the 4th respondent,
the third respondent is interfering with his business.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 4.
At the outset, this Court is of the view that the writ petition is nothing but abuse of process of law.
The power vested with the officers under the Food Safety Act is to inspect the place and collect the samples to check adulteration.
When such being the position, by way of filing the writ petition, their statutory duties cannot be curtailed.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
No costs.
The Corporation Commissioner, O/corporation Office, Dindigul District - 624001..
